name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return in the decompiled output, so it is a stub that does no work. Its facts show two instructions, two unnamed callers and one unnamed callee.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return in the decompiled output and no other work, so it is a stub. Four unnamed routines call it, and it has a single instruction.

name: return_unrecovered_routine_body
description: The decompiled body is only a return even though the routine spans 28 instructions, so its logic is not recovered from this evidence. Two unnamed routines call it.

name: copy_five_words_between_blocks
description: Copies five values from one block of state into another block a fixed distance further on, with source and destination stepping by the same stride. It is reached only because the gap between known routines decodes as code, so its callers are unknown.

name: compute_matrix_vector_product
description: Calls three unnamed routines first, then computes three results, each a sum of three products of stored matrix entries and stored vector components, doubled and shifted right by 16 bits. The results are written to three consecutive words of the state block.

name: transform_vector_by_matrix
description: Calls three unnamed routines and then computes the same three matrix-vector results as the preceding routine, storing them into the state block. Each product sum is doubled and shifted right by 16 bits.

name: transform_vector_by_matrix_table
description: Reads three values through one pointer, multiplies them by a 3-by-3 matrix read through a second pointer, and writes three doubled and shifted sums through a third pointer. It makes no calls.

name: cycle_stored_coordinate_slots
description: Depending on a flag in a linked record, it either adds scaled stored values to three record fields or follows three record links. It then calls unnamed routines and rotates values between pairs of stored slots.

name: build_negated_vector_table
description: Reads three values from a state record, selecting the record fields by a flag, and multiplies them with a stored 3-by-3 matrix to produce four vectors, each shifted right when a flag is set. Each vector is written to an output table together with its negated copy.

name: subtract_indexed_record_values
description: Uses two indices from the input table to read two words at a fixed offset inside a record, and returns their difference with its sign in the high half. It is called from one unnamed routine and sits in code the disassembler decoded from a gap.

name: compute_triangle_facing_dot
description: Reads three vertex references, halves their coordinate differences to form a cross-product-like normal, and shifts the terms until they fit a 16-bit range. It returns minus one when a clip-style check fails, otherwise a dot product of that normal with three values offset by a global value.

name: clip_check_weighted_sum
description: Takes its inputs from registers set by the caller, runs the same clip-style check as the preceding routine, and returns a weighted sum of three values offset by a global value. It returns minus one when the check fails.

name: divide_fixed_point_signed
description: Delegates cases where either operand is negative to other unnamed routines. For a dividend below the divisor it computes a fixed-point quotient estimate, while equal operands return the constant 8192 and other cases are delegated.

name: divide_fixed_point_positive
description: For a non-negative divisor, it computes a fixed-point quotient estimate when the divisor exceeds the dividend and returns 8192 when the operands are equal. Negative divisors and the other unequal case are delegated to another routine.

name: estimate_fixed_point_quotient
description: When the dividend is below the divisor it computes a fixed-point quotient estimate with a correction term. Other unequal operands are delegated to another routine, and equal operands return the constant 8192.

name: scale_quotient_and_swap_halves
description: Divides the first input by the high word of the second input, then scales the quotient with a correction term that depends on it. It returns the 32-bit product with its two 16-bit halves swapped.

name: walk_record_list_dispatch
description: Walks a linked list starting from a pointer stored at offset 110 of the object. For each record it calls one of two unnamed routines depending on whether the byte at offset 94 is below 10.

name: release_or_requeue_record
description: When the byte at offset 94 is 10 or more, it moves the record to the front of a list after two unnamed calls. Otherwise it clears a matching slot in a small table, unlinks the record, stamps marker values into its fields, and moves it to the front unless it sits at a fixed address.

name: insert_record_at_list_head
description: Inserts a record at the front of a doubly linked list after two unnamed routine calls. It sets the record's back pointer to the list anchor and the old head's back pointer to the record.

name: move_record_to_list_head
description: Removes a record from its doubly linked list and makes it the new head, unless it already is the anchor or sits at a fixed address. It stamps a marker value and an unused tag into the record's fields and calls two unnamed routines.

name: count_linked_list_nodes
description: Resets a shared counter to zero, then walks a linked list of records and increments the counter once per record. It is reached only because the gap between known routines decodes as code.

name: expire_stale_records_in_slot
description: Steps a shared index down, wrapping it to 395 when it was zero, and walks the list for that slot. For records meeting several flag, zero-field and age conditions it calls an unnamed routine, and sets a timer field to 1500 in some cases.

name: scan_chain_for_positive_field
description: Walks a chain of records from a fixed start address and calls an unnamed routine on the first record whose field at offset 110 is positive. When the chain ends it returns the last field value with the input registers unchanged.

name: allocate_free_record
description: Takes a record from a free list and clears its fields and two marker words before returning it. When the free list is empty it searches a chain for a record with a particular flag bit, reuses that record, and otherwise loops.

name: link_record_into_slot_list
description: Stores the input index in the record's field at offset 82, then inserts the record at the front of the list anchored in the slot table for that index unless it is already the head. It keeps the forward and back pointers of the neighbouring records consistent.

name: unlink_record_from_slot_list
description: Marks the record's slot index at offset 82 as unused and removes it from its doubly linked list by joining its neighbours. It sets the index to minus one before the unlink.

name: unlink_and_clear_slot_index
description: Sets the record's slot index at offset 82 to minus one and unlinks it from its list by joining the neighbouring records. It works on a record held in a different address register than its sibling routine.

name: unlink_record_from_secondary_list
description: If the record's link at offset 106 is set, it marks that link as unused and removes the record from a second list at offset 102. The neighbouring records are joined so the list stays intact.

name: insert_record_into_secondary_list
description: When the record's link at offset 106 is not set, it inserts the record at the front of a secondary list whose head is the shared global. It updates the forward link at offset 102 and the head pointer.

name: initialise_record_pool
description: Clears a block of words, sets the shared head pointers and default values, and links a pool of records into a free list at a fixed stride. It writes default fields into the first record and ends the list with a null link.

name: process_indexed_table_entry
description: Looks up an indexed entry in a table and, when its byte at offset 26 is neither zero nor minus one, derives a value from its byte at offset 35 and calls an unnamed routine. It always leaves the shared index at minus one.

name: load_word_into_global
description: Copies the first word of the record addressed by the input register into the shared global variable and returns. It is a single load with no other effects.

name: update_record_state_code
description: Updates a state word at offset 32 of the record from an input byte, stepping it up when the byte is in range and otherwise storing a fixed marker code. Certain paths also mirror the marker into an indexed table entry and call unnamed routines when the record is the current one.

name: set_state_if_slot_matches
description: If the record's slot value at offset 36 differs from the reference record's slot at offset 82, it stores a fixed marker code and returns. Otherwise it stores the input word and calls an unnamed routine when the low byte is fifteen and the slots match.

name: forward_to_unnamed_routine
description: Calls a single unnamed routine and returns, with no other work in the decompiled code. It is a thin forwarder to that call.

name: advance_record_frame_timer
description: Counts down a frame timer in the record and, when it expires, reloads the timer from its reset value and runs the frame reload. Otherwise it sets the timer to four and returns.

name: reload_record_frame_data
description: Resets a frame timer from its reset value, clears a flag bit, and copies the 36-long data block of the entry chosen by a cumulative count into the record. It then sets several fields from a lookup table, clears two link fields, and calls unnamed routines.

name: scan_list_for_stop_record
description: Walks a list of records from the input record's list head and returns minus one when it finds a record with a specific type word, a flagged record, or the shared global record. It returns zero when the list ends, and when the input record heads its indexed slot it calls an unnamed routine first.

name: tick_record_countdown
description: When a shared flag is set and a record's field at offset 8 is nonzero, it counts down the field at offset 12. When that countdown reaches zero it decrements the field at offset 8 and calls unnamed routines.

name: initialise_record_from_table_entry
description: Counts down a timer on the record and, when it reaches zero, copies several fields from a lookup table entry selected by a fixed index. It then sets default state fields on the record and calls unnamed routines to finish setup.

name: initialise_record_state_fields
description: Copies fields from a lookup table entry selected by a fixed index into the record and clears several related fields. It then sets a state code from the shared global and calls unnamed routines to finish setup.

name: reset_record_default_fields
description: Sets the record's fields at offsets 30 and 42 to fixed defaults and clears its field at offset 124. It also clears the shared global variable.

name: set_record_state_from_global
description: When the shared global is non-negative, it copies that value into two record fields, sets a default field, and resets the global to 255. Otherwise it sets the default fields and clears the global.

name: apply_table_entry_to_record
description: Stores a fixed value in the record's field at offset 30 and copies a table entry chosen by the shared global into two record fields. It clears related fields and then resets the shared global variable.

name: flag_records_matching_mask
description: Walks a table of groups and, for each record referenced by an index, sets bit one of a status word when the record has a particular flag, the masked input matches, and two of its counters differ. It covers every group in the table.

name: dispatch_slot_records_by_mask
description: Walks the slot table and, for each slot whose index nibble matches the shared value and whose mask bits overlap it, calls a routine chosen from a table. It then scans the slot's entries and calls an unnamed routine on those with a negative field.

name: resolve_slot_for_record
description: When the record's slot index at offset 82 is valid, it looks up that slot and derives a flag from a mask bit. It then calls unnamed routines to act on that flag.

name: copy_transform_restore_matrix
description: Checks that three offsets relative to a reference record fit in a 16-bit range, then copies a 3-by-3 matrix into an output block. It applies a transform when the record has a nonzero selector and restores the saved matrix before returning.

name: load_long_into_global
description: Copies the 32-bit value at the address given in the input register into the shared global variable and returns. It has no other effect.

name: find_or_store_list_value
description: Looks up a table entry for the input index and, if it is inactive or flagged, searches an associated list for a matching value and stores the combined value into an empty slot. Where no match is found it returns twice a stored word or continues with further updates.

name: restore_saved_matrix_block
description: When the shared global is at most four, it adjusts the global, calls an unnamed routine with an offset from a table, and then restores the saved matrix block. Otherwise it returns immediately.

name: find_flagged_entry_value
description: Scans entries from the input table until one has a nonzero flag byte at offset 10 of the record, then returns twice its word. When none is flagged and the record is absent, it calls unnamed routines and returns zero or their result.

name: compute_clipped_extent
description: Adds a table value to the input extent and returns a flagged result when the sum is negative. Otherwise it returns a scaled extent and its difference from the table value, substituting the absolute value of a second input when that is within range.

name: compute_clipped_extent_direct
description: Adds the input extent and offset, returning a flagged result when the sum is negative. Otherwise it returns a scaled extent and its difference from the offset, substituting the absolute value of a second input when that is within range.

name: update_record_list_extents
description: Walks a list of records from the owner's list head and stores three input values into each record's fields, setting a flag bit when a shared value is zero. For records whose state passes a check it updates a running value and calls unnamed routines to finish the pass.

name: traverse_child_links_with_stack
description: Walks a tree of linked records by following the child slots from offset 6 onward, keeping a small stack in the frame. It calls an unnamed routine at each node it visits.

name: reset_shared_global
description: Sets the shared global variable to zero twice and returns. It has no other effect.

name: append_keyed_record_entry
description: Walks a chain of keyed entries in a shared buffer and, when the key is not already present, appends a new entry holding the key, a zero link, the address-register value and a 16-bit value. It then advances the shared allocation pointer past the new entry.

name: clear_global_after_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then sets the shared global variable to zero and returns the input registers unchanged. It is a call followed by a reset.

name: reset_flagged_records_state
description: Walks a chain of records from a fixed start and, for each record with flag bit 1024 set, sets status bits and writes fixed default values into its fields at offsets 30, 32 and 26. Records without that flag are left alone.

name: reset_flagged_records_from_head
description: Walks a chain of records starting from the input pointer and, for each record with flag bit 1024 set, sets status bits and writes fixed default values into its fields at offsets 30, 32 and 26. It stops when the chain ends.

name: add_offset_to_record_field
description: Adds 800 to the record's field at offset 24 and returns. It is a single adjustment with no other effect.

name: advance_record_position_fields
description: Derives two increments from the record's field at offset 32 by shifting it right, and adds them to the record's fields at offsets 118 and 116. It then calls an unnamed routine.

name: derive_flagged_shift_value
description: Checks flag bit 8192 in the record's status word at offset 10, which sets the shared global to minus one when present. When set it calls an unnamed routine, takes the high byte of its result, and derives a clamped value into the shared global.

name: collect_record_flag_bits
description: Converts a series of flag bits from the record's status words into minus-one or zero values stored in the shared global. It sets the shared global to 255 when the field at offset 30 equals a specific value and the field at offset 42 is 15 or 11.

name: compare_slot_timing_gate
description: When two records share the same slot index and the slot's byte at offset 35 is zero, it reads a value from an unnamed routine. It returns minus one when that value is below 301, and zero otherwise.

name: scan_slot_entries_for_threshold
description: Scans the entries of a slot for an active one that passes a type check, and returns the difference between a running value and the entry's field at offset 12 once a threshold comparison holds. Entries that fail are passed to an unnamed routine and the scan continues.

name: scan_records_by_distance_ratio
description: Walks a list of records and, for each record without certain flags whose squared offset from the input point stays in range, calls an unnamed routine when a scaled ratio passes a table threshold. Records with the excluded flags are skipped.

name: lookup_scaled_level_value
description: Converts the record's field at offset 32 into a level index by shifting it right five bits, clamping the index at 15 and treating negative values as zero. It then stores the matching word from a level table into the shared global.

name: lookup_level_table_entry
description: Shifts the input value right five bits, clamps the index at 15, and stores the matching word from a level table into the shared global. It has no sign handling.

name: fetch_record_table_pair
description: Reads two words from a table indexed by the record's field at offset 12. When the record is the one held in the shared global, it toggles that global and negates the first value when the toggled result is zero.

name: dispatch_by_jump_table
description: When the shared global is nonzero and above 512, it dispatches through a jump table indexed by the global, which the decompiler could not recover. Otherwise it calls an unnamed routine and returns the input registers.

name: mask_value_by_state_code
description: Sets the low eight bits of the input value and, depending on the shared global, calls unnamed routines. The branch for a state value of two is only partly recoverable from this code.

name: forward_call_returning_input
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns the input register values unchanged. It has no other effect.

name: spawn_record_from_slot_entry
description: When the active table entry for the shared index has type two, it marks that entry unused and copies transformed matrix values into the record. It then sets default extents, scaled coordinates and state fields on the record and calls unnamed routines.

name: spawn_slot_record_returning_entry
description: Performs the same slot-entry spawn as its neighbour: when the active entry for the shared index has type two, it marks it unused, copies transformed values and default fields into the record, and calls several unnamed routines. It returns the table word for that index.

name: conditionally_call_and_return
description: Tests the shared global and, when it is zero, calls an unnamed routine and returns the input value. Otherwise it returns the input value unchanged, sometimes after a further call.

name: call_unnamed_routine_only
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns without other work. It is a call with no further effect.

name: set_global_flag_then_call
description: Sets the shared global to one, calls an unnamed routine to obtain a value, calls another unnamed routine, and returns that value with the register pair.

name: select_record_flag_path
description: Branches on bit 1 of the record's flag word at offset 8. When the bit is clear it calls two unnamed routines; when it is set it sets the shared global to 255 or to one before calling them.

name: set_flag_and_call_pair
description: Sets the shared global to 255 when it is zero or to one otherwise, then calls two unnamed routines. It returns the value from the first call with the register pair.

name: initialise_moving_record_state
description: Places a record relative to a source record, copies scaled velocity components from a matrix block, and limits one component when the source is active and the shared target is out of band. It then sets default timing and state fields and calls unnamed routines.

name: setup_moving_record_from_source
description: Performs the same placement and velocity setup as its neighbour, after clearing the shared global. It copies scaled components, limits one against a shared target, sets default state fields, and calls unnamed routines.

name: setup_moving_record_no_reset
description: Places a record relative to a source record, copies scaled velocity components from a matrix block, and limits one against a shared target when the source is active. It sets default timing and state fields and calls unnamed routines, without resetting the shared global.

name: increment_global_capped_at_nine
description: Adds one to the shared global variable and clamps it at nine.

name: decrement_global_floor_four
description: Subtracts one from the shared global variable and clamps it to a minimum of four.

name: subtract_global_clamped_field
description: Subtracts the shared global from the record's field at offset 22 and clamps the result at minus 16384.

name: add_global_clamped_field
description: Adds the shared global to the record's field at offset 22 and clamps the result at 16384.

name: accumulate_global_into_field
description: Adds the shared global variable to the record's field at offset 24 with no limit applied.

name: subtract_global_from_field
description: Subtracts the shared global variable from the record's field at offset 24 with no limit applied.

name: dispatch_bit_flags_for_entry
description: Looks up an entry for the shared index and returns if it is absent. When the entry's field at offset 30 is nonzero it records the index at offset 66; otherwise it decodes a bit pattern from a table and calls unnamed routines for each set bit.

name: cap_field_by_global_sum
description: Adds the shared global to the record's field at offset 26 and caps the result at the shared global value.

name: decay_field_toward_limit
description: When bit two of the shared global is set, it derives the global from the sign of the record's field at offset 26. It then subtracts the global from that field and keeps it at or above a lower bound taken from the global.

name: decrement_field_with_floor
description: Subtracts 400 from the record's field at offset 118 and clamps the result at minus 16000.

name: increment_field_with_ceiling
description: Adds 400 to the record's field at offset 118 and caps the result at 16000.

name: clamp_field_28_toward_limit
description: When bit four of the shared global is set, it derives the global from the sign of the record's field at offset 28. It then adds the global to that field and caps the result at 4096, or at zero when the global is nonzero.

name: clamp_field_28_toward_zero
description: When bit eight of the shared global is set, it derives the global from the sign of the record's field at offset 28. It then subtracts the global from that field and keeps it at or above minus 4096, or at zero when the global is nonzero.

name: snapshot_record_position
description: When the record's field at offset 26 is zero, it clears the shared global and copies the record's three position fields into fields at offsets 84, 86 and 88. It then calls an unnamed routine.

name: snapshot_record_position_alt
description: Runs the same position snapshot as its neighbour when the record's field at offset 26 is zero, copying three position fields into offsets 84, 86 and 88. It then calls unnamed routines.

name: set_global_and_scale_field
description: Stores the input value in the shared global, sets the record's field at offset 16 to that value minus 78, and then stores the input multiplied by the global, shifted right four bits, back into the global.

name: update_record_motion_state
description: Adjusts the shared global from its previous value, and depending on the record's flags it sets the field at offset 132 to the negated global and marks bit 32 in its status word. It sets one field to a fixed value and calls unnamed routines in several branches.

name: reduce_global_by_scaled_shift
description: Reduces the shared global by a shifted copy of itself, with the shift set to zero, one or three by thresholds of sixty and ninety, and clamps the result at zero.

name: process_record_pending_state
description: Processes a record's pending state from the shared global, checking the global's low bits and a table entry. It calls unnamed routines to update the record's position and flags and returns the value from the final call.

name: step_field_26_toward_zero
description: When the shared global is zero and the record's status bit 32 is clear, it moves the field at offset 26 toward zero by the global's magnitude. It clears the field when the step would cross zero.

name: step_field_28_toward_zero
description: Moves the record's field at offset 28 toward zero by the shared global's magnitude when bit 32 of the status word is clear and the global's mask bits permit it. It clears the field when the step would cross zero.

name: test_record_inside_region
description: Checks whether the record's position lies inside any region of a list, unless its type word is one of two excluded values. It sets bit 64 of its status word and stores the matching region when found, and clears the bit otherwise.

name: mark_record_motion_state
description: When bit 32 of the record's status word is clear, it sets that bit and clears the field at offset 132. It calls an unnamed routine unless bit 2048 was already set.

name: mark_record_motion_state_alt
description: Performs the same status update as its neighbour: it sets bit 32 when clear and calls an unnamed routine unless bit 2048 was already set. It is the same check without the separate field clear.

name: relink_and_reposition_record
description: Unlinks a large record from its current list, recomputes its position from a table entry and the input offsets, and relinks it into the list for its slot. It then checks a range and calls unnamed routines, but the decompiled output is cut off before the final steps.

name: insert_record_and_zero_offsets
description: Inserts the record at the front of the list headed by the shared global, then sets its fields at offsets 14 and 18 to zero.

name: update_or_retire_record
description: When status bit 128 of the record is clear, it restores saved position fields and sets bit 4. Otherwise it either unlinks the record from its list and marks its slot as unused, or sets a high status bit on a linked record, and it calls several unnamed routines.

name: call_when_global_magnitude_large
description: Takes the magnitude of the shared global and calls an unnamed routine when that magnitude shifted right four bits is nonzero. It returns the input registers unchanged.

name: link_nearby_records_if_close
description: When neither record has its flagged status bits set, it computes a weighted displacement between them and, if it is within the shared limit, sets link fields on both records. Otherwise it clears both links.

name: scan_slot_neighbours_for_contact
description: Clears the low two status bits of a record and, unless bit 4 is set, scans the list of records in its slot for neighbours inside a distance threshold. Qualifying neighbours get their status bits updated and may trigger an unnamed routine.

name: update_record_with_paired_state
description: Handles the motion-state branch of a record when a flag bit is set, adjusting the paired record's status bits and a timer. It then sets fixed state values, including a countdown of 1000, and calls unnamed routines; the decompiled output is cut off before the end.

name: apply_timer_to_record_state
description: Applies the input timer value to the record's state, setting or clearing status bits and fixed state fields depending on flags and table values. It calls unnamed routines along the way and returns the updated value.

name: visit_record_chain_entries
description: Walks a chain of records from the list pointer at offset 110 of the object and calls two unnamed routines for each record in the chain.

name: dispatch_table_entries_countdown
description: When the shared global is zero, it looks up a list of entries from a table indexed by the record's field at offset 12 and calls an unnamed routine for each entry, counting down from the list length.

name: spawn_record_from_table_block
description: Looks up a table entry for the record's index and returns early when a threshold is not met. Otherwise it copies a 36-long block into the record, sets its position, flags and default fields from a table, marks it active, and calls unnamed routines.

name: place_record_relative_to_parent
description: Sets a status bit and a fixed value at offset 30 on the record, then positions it from the parent record's coordinates plus offsets derived from an unnamed routine's result. It sets a size field and a fixed value at offset 132, then marks an active bit and calls unnamed routines.

name: return_unrecovered_large_body
description: The decompiled body is only a return although the routine spans 127 instructions and lists nine unnamed callees, so its behaviour is not recovered here. It is reached only because gap decoding treats it as code.

name: check_coordinate_within_range
description: Compares an input coordinate against a range taken from a record, but both outcomes return without any effect in the decompiled output. The check therefore shows no visible result.

name: repeat_call_for_count
description: Reads a count from the input pointer and calls an unnamed routine once for each step of a countdown from that count. It returns early when the loop's wraparound flag is set.

name: check_point_in_box
description: Tests whether an input point lies inside the box described by six words at the input pointer, but both outcomes return with no effect in the decompiled output.

name: integrate_record_velocity
description: Advances the record's timer by its rate field, then either applies a scaled table-driven velocity to its position or adds its stored offset fields to its position. It sets the shared global to 255 when the record is active.

name: accumulate_scaled_velocity_step
description: Scales two table entries by an input value, adds them into the record's accumulated velocity words with carry, and updates its position from the carry-adjusted results.

name: update_record_frame_motion
description: Advances a record's offset with a clamped step, and when a slot-table limit is exceeded it resets the record's timer and state fields. It sets several status flags and calls unnamed routines that depend on the record type and the shared global.

name: call_two_unnamed_routines
description: Calls two unnamed routines in sequence and returns, with no other work.

name: manage_record_countdown_flag
description: Manages a countdown in the record's field at offset 122 and bit 4096 of its status word. It clears the flag when a condition fails, sets it with a count of 15 when the low status bits are small enough, and otherwise counts the countdown down until the flag clears.

name: update_active_record_list
description: Walks the list of active records from the shared head, copying each record's position into its snapshot fields and dispatching records with a nonzero state code through a computed call table. Records with flags set go through further checks, and the walk stops at the end of the list.

name: set_record_position_from_table
description: Sets the record's field at offset 24 from the input index, then computes its position from a source record's coordinates plus table-scaled offsets derived from the same index and the input values.

name: step_record_counter_and_index
description: Advances a counter at offset 126 by four. While it stays below 255 it stores the counter scaled by sixteen in offset 22, copies the source record's slot index, and calls an unnamed routine; otherwise it sets fixed values and copies the slot index into the shared global.

name: advance_counter_below_limit
description: Advances the counter at offset 126 by four, and calls an unnamed routine only when the shared global is non-negative or the counter is below 320.

name: compute_clamped_step_for_record
description: Computes a step for the record relative to an input record, using slot-matched checks and a table-driven value. It applies the step to the field at offset 24, limited to plus or minus 400 when flag bit 4096 is set and to plus or minus 1024 otherwise, and returns the clamped step or a fixed maximum of 32767.

name: step_field24_toward_negated_value
description: Moves the record's field at offset 24 toward the negated value from an unnamed routine, with each step limited to plus or minus 400 when flag bit 4096 is set and plus or minus 1024 otherwise.

name: step_field24_toward_negated_alt
description: Performs the same limited step toward the negated value as its neighbour, using the same flag-dependent limits of plus or minus 400 and plus or minus 1024.

name: step_field24_negated_call_result
description: Repeats the limited move of the field at offset 24 toward the negated call result, with the same flag-dependent limits. It is the same routine as its neighbour, reached from a different caller.

name: step_field24_toward_input_value
description: Moves the record's field at offset 24 toward the input value, with each step limited to plus or minus 400 when flag bit 4096 is set and plus or minus 1024 otherwise.

name: sync_field_when_type_matches
description: For records whose type word is one of two codes, copies the field at offset 118 into the field at offset 74 whenever they differ, and calls an unnamed routine if flag bit 8192 is set. It clears bit 4096 of the status word before returning.

name: step_field118_within_bounds
description: Moves the record's field at offset 118 toward a value from an unnamed routine, limiting each step to plus or minus 4096. It then keeps the result between the bounds at offsets 114 and 116.

name: step_field118_toward_negated_sum
description: Steps the field at offset 118 toward the negated sum of the field at offset 24 and an unnamed routine's value, limited to plus or minus 4096. It then keeps the result between the bounds at offsets 114 and 116.

name: step_field118_negated_sum_alt
description: Performs the same bounded step as its neighbour, moving the field at offset 118 toward the negated sum and keeping it between the bounds at offsets 114 and 116.

name: find_other_active_record
description: Searches the owner's list for a record other than the input that lacks flag bit 64, has a nonzero field at offset 26, and has a table value of at least 41. It returns minus one when one is found and zero otherwise.

name: run_record_state_countdown
description: Counts down a timer at offset 120 and, when it reaches zero, selects a state from the record's type and the shared global. It may call unnamed routines, reset the countdown to 24, set a new type code and a timer of 60, and set status bit 32.

name: set_field26_to_sixty
description: Sets the record's field at offset 26 to 60 and returns.

name: estimate_record_distance
description: Computes an approximate distance between the two records from their horizontal and vertical offsets, returning the larger offset plus half of the smaller.

name: estimate_distance_from_point
description: Computes the same approximate distance as its neighbour, between an input point and the record's horizontal and vertical offsets.

name: estimate_weighted_magnitude_sum
description: Takes the absolute values of three inputs, sorts them, and returns the largest plus half the middle value plus a quarter of the smallest.

name: update_record_timer_from_distance
description: Resets the record's field at offset 28 and, when the input record shares its slot index, sets the field at offset 26 from a computed value capped at 60 and may toggle a flag byte at offset 42. Otherwise it zeroes the field at offset 26 and sets the field at offset 28 to 400.

name: reset_record_timer_fields
description: Sets the record's field at offset 26 to zero and its field at offset 28 to 400.

name: initialise_new_record_defaults
description: Initialises a new record by clearing its countdown fields and setting status bit 512. It places the record from an input position with a table-derived size and fixed default values, then sets a type code and a timer at offset 30 and calls unnamed routines.

name: select_state_code_from_record
description: When status bit 8192 is clear it sets the shared global to one of two fixed codes and returns. Otherwise it derives a code from the high byte of a value and sets the shared global to one of three codes, depending on the record's field at offset 136.

name: call_pair_of_unnamed_routines
description: Calls two unnamed routines in sequence and returns, with no other work.

name: spawn_record_batch_loop
description: Loops a count of times, placing a new record for each step at positions offset from the input point. Each record gets fixed defaults, a type code and a timer value of 48, and the loop then calls unnamed routines.

name: advance_field36_capped
description: Adds 6 to the record's field at offset 36 with a cap of 30, and sets its field at offset 26 to 48.

name: call_routine_for_table_entries
description: Walks a zero-terminated table of words starting at a fixed address and calls an unnamed routine for each non-zero entry. It returns zero when the table ends.

name: dispatch_record_code_jump_table
description: Looks up a word through a pointer in the record at offset 20 and calls one of several unnamed routines through a jump table indexed by that word. The decompiler could not recover the jump table itself.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains a single return with no other work, so it is a stub with no visible behaviour.

name: set_word_when_flag_clear
description: When the record's byte at offset 33 is zero, it stores one in the word at the output pointer. Otherwise it leaves the output unchanged.

name: record_slot_state_when_present
description: Records the shared index into an indexed entry and, when a slot head exists, calls an unnamed routine. It copies the input word into an output record and sets that record's status to one or eight depending on a comparison with a reference word.

name: find_matching_triplet_entry
description: Scans 12-byte entries of a table, starting at the input base, for one whose three words match the three input values. It returns when a match is found or when an entry's marker word is negative.

name: find_entry_by_word_key
description: Scans 12-byte entries from the input base for one whose word at offset 6 equals the input word. It stops at an entry whose marker word at offset 10 is negative.

name: scan_slot_entries_for_word
description: Scans the entries of the record's slot for one whose word at offset 34 matches the input word, stopping when the entry count is exhausted. It leaves the scan position in the registers and returns nothing.

name: classify_record_extent
description: When the record's size pairs are small enough, it shifts the value in its field at offset 12 toward zero by 150. Extents over 200 return that value unchanged, and the other cases return the input unchanged.

name: evaluate_record_contact_response
description: Checks the shared global's low five bits and the record's flag and slot match, then computes a clamped response from two unnamed routine values. It may set the shared global and call unnamed routines, comparing the result against fixed thresholds.

name: call_when_value_in_band
description: Returns the input value unchanged unless its low word lies in a fixed middle range. Inside that range it sets the shared global to one and calls two unnamed routines.

name: check_sum_within_limit
description: Adds the value from an unnamed routine to the record's field at offset 24 and takes the magnitude. When the magnitude is at most 2048 it calls two unnamed routines and returns the result, otherwise it returns the magnitude.

name: dispatch_matching_table_entry
description: Stores the input value in the record's field at offset 128, then scans a table of word pairs for that value. It calls the unnamed routine selected by the paired offset, stops at a negative entry, and then calls two more unnamed routines.

name: append_to_ring_buffer
description: Appends the input word to a buffer whose pointer is held in the shared global, advancing the pointer and wrapping it to a fixed start when it passes a fixed end. It writes a marker word first when the buffer pointer is unset.

name: wrap_buffer_pointer
description: Wraps the buffer pointer in the input register to a fixed start when it passes a fixed end, and stores the result in the shared global.

name: collect_slot_entry_indices
description: Walks the entries of the record's slot and writes each entry's index into a shared buffer, skipping entries whose type byte is zero or two. It writes a negative terminator at the end and calls unnamed routines for some entries.

name: store_slot_index_from_record
description: Copies the record's field at offset 34 into the output word, and when the indexed slot has flag bits 2048 or 8192 set, also stores it in the shared global.

name: find_value_in_index_buffer
description: Scans the index buffer for the input value and returns when it finds the value or reaches a negative terminator.

name: append_unique_byte
description: Maps the input byte into a small bounded table, appending it when it is not already present and advancing the table count held in the shared global. A value above eleven is first replaced by an unnamed routine's result.

name: scan_index_list_for_slot
description: Scans a list of indices, starting from the shared global list or from the record's pointer at offset 34, for the record's slot value. It returns when the value is found or the list ends with a negative marker.

name: reset_and_scan_index_list
description: Resets the shared global through a short sequence of fixed values, then scans a list of indices for the record's slot value. It resets the globals again when the list ends with a negative marker.

name: scan_index_list_then_reset
description: Sets the shared global to fixed values, scans the index list for the record's slot value, and resets the global to fixed values when the list ends.

name: scan_word_list_for_value
description: Scans a list of words from the input pointer for the input value and returns at the first match or at a negative terminator.

name: reset_record_for_state_setup
description: Clears the record's field at offset 126, calls an unnamed routine, and then sets fields at offsets 26, 36 and 42. The flag that selects the branch is a constant true in the decompiled output, so only the first set of fields is written.

name: set_default_state_marker
description: Stores a fixed value in the record's field at offset 58 and sets its field at offset 42 to 10.

name: step_field118_by_fixed_amount
description: When status bit 4096 is set, it steps the field at offset 118 up or down by 1536 depending on bit 1024. It clamps the result to the bounds at offsets 114 and 116 and flips bit 1024 when a bound is reached.

name: reset_record_mode_fields
description: Sets the record's field at offset 42 to nine and its field at offset 124 to 16, then clears bit 32768 of its status word.

name: transition_record_state
description: When status bit 2 is set, it counts down a timer at offset 124 and checks the state code at offset 42 against several fixed codes. It may move the record to another state code, storing the previous code at offset 66, and otherwise sets the state code to fifteen.

name: steer_field16_toward_target
description: Moves the record's field at offset 16 toward the input record's value by at most 30 per step, unless status bit 1 or 4 is set, in which case it sets a timer at offset 30 to 1500. It sets a countdown at offset 26 and clears it when an unnamed routine's result falls outside a band of plus or minus 200.

name: step_field16_and_check_band
description: Adds an input step to the record's field at offset 16, floored at minus 30, and sets a countdown at offset 26 to 30. It clears that countdown when an unnamed routine's result falls outside a band of plus or minus 200.

name: clear_field26
description: Sets the record's field at offset 26 to zero.

name: set_field30_to_1500
description: Sets the record's field at offset 30 to 1500.

name: accumulate_scaled_offset
description: When status bit 8192 is set and bit 8 is clear, it adds a table-scaled step to the record's field at offset 22. When the record is the shared global it advances the field at offset 138 by its field at offset 26 times 28, wrapping at a table limit.

name: advance_field32_up_to_limit
description: Clamps the record's field at offset 32 to at least zero, adds eight, and caps the result at a limit read from the table entry for the record's type.

name: initialise_record_state_dispatch
description: Resets the record's state code at offset 42 and countdown at offset 124, and copies its field at offset 34 into offset 54. It sets the field at offset 30 to one of two fixed values depending on its type range, then calls unnamed routines and dispatches to a handler through a jump table indexed by the state code.

name: dispatch_record_state_handler
description: Clears the record's countdown at offset 126 and, when its state code is not eleven or fifteen, calls an unnamed routine. It then dispatches to a handler through a jump table indexed by the state code at offset 42.

name: call_pair_and_reset_global
description: Calls two unnamed routines, then sets the shared global to zero, 255 and 65535 in turn, leaving it at 65535.

name: dispatch_by_input_index
description: Calls the routine selected by the input word from a jump table that the decompiler could not recover.

name: resolve_record_link_or_dispatch
description: Follows the record's pointer at offset 54 to a value, returning minus one when the record is the shared global and a flagged slot applies. Otherwise it returns a non-negative table word, and for a negative word it dispatches through a jump table.

name: scan_word_list_until_repeat
description: Scans a list of words starting at the input pointer and returns at a negative terminator or at the next entry equal to the first word.

name: search_slot_entries_for_type
description: Searches the record's slot entries for one with a suitable type byte and no flagged link, raising that entry's type code to six when it is below seven, and returns its index. It returns minus one when no entry qualifies.

name: update_record_link_state
description: Works from the slot of the record's parent, and when that slot is unoccupied it sets the record's status and timer fields from its type and the parent's index. It calls unnamed routines, may dispatch to a handler through a jump table, and returns the record's index or a flagged value.

name: resolve_record_link_state_alt
description: Scans a linked list for a record with status bit 2048 and returns that bit when it finds one. Otherwise it applies the same slot-index and timer updates as its neighbour and calls unnamed routines before returning.

name: stub_return_only_two
description: Contains only a return with no other work, so it is a stub with no visible behaviour.

name: store_index_status_word
description: When the record's slot index at offset 82 is zero, it stores the input word at offset 4 of the output block and sets the output's first word to eight or one depending on how the input compares with the word at offset 6. Otherwise it sets the record's field at offset 30 to 1500.
